name: deepseek-worker
description: Plan and review in the main session, and hand mechanical coding steps to a headless Claude Code run on the paid DeepSeek API (mk-exec), with its own config dir, effort low, medium or high, and a full log per run. Includes /mk-delegate, /mk-check (which installs mk-exec, workflow-report and the worker config from its references), the orchestration rule as a resolved dep, and the worker-mode guard hook (installs with sigil add; plugins can't carry hooks yet). Requires Claude Code and a DeepSeek API key. Works with any language.
